tbesh_html:
1) to quake, shake
1a) (Qal) to quake, shake
1b) (Niphal) to be made to quake
1c)(Hiphil)
1c1) to cause to quake
1c2) to cause to spring or leap (of horse)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to undulate (as the earth, the sky, etc.; also a field of grain), particularly through fear; specifically, to spring (as a locust)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: make afraid, (re-) move, quake, (make to) shake, (make to) tremble.
